title: Tensor transport for the recorded integral line
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], $\ell$ a prime invertible in every residue field of both schemes, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Set $R_{E,T}=\varprojlim_{n\geq0}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $L_T=\varprojlim_n\mu_{\ell^{n+1},T}$ [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and $N_{E,T}=(\mathcal O_E)_T\otimes_{(\mathbf Z_\ell)_T}L_T$ with the completed action of [def-pur-twist-sheaves]. Supply isomorphisms $\alpha:h^{-1}R_{E,Y}\to R_{E,X}$ and $\tau:h^{-1}L_Y\to L_X$, with all projection equations $\alpha\pi_{X,n}=h^{-1}(\pi_{Y,n})\delta_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}}$ and $\tau\operatorname{pr}_{X,n}=h^{-1}(\operatorname{pr}_{Y,n})c^h_{\mu_{\ell^{n+1}}}$, using the recorded constant-section and root comparisons [def-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image]. Then there exists an additive isomorphism $\rho:h^{-1}N_{E,Y}\to N_{E,X}$ whose actual adjunct sends every local pure tensor $b\otimes t$ over $V\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to $\widetilde\delta_{\mathcal O_E,V}(b)\otimes\widetilde\tau_V(t)$ over $V\times_Y X$. Its adjunct is semilinear over the adjunct of $\alpha$: $\widetilde\rho_V(a\cdot s)=\widetilde\alpha_V(a)\cdot\widetilde\rho_V(s)$ for every local completed scalar $a$ and line section $s$. This conclusion constructs neither $\alpha$ nor $\tau$ and asserts no field-inclusion square.

proof.text: Projection uniqueness identifies alpha with the normalized completed coefficient comparison. The normalized coefficient tensor square and epsilon square identify the discrete and completed scalar structures.
Test the root action after every root projection: the finite root inverse-image comparisons are semilinear, hence tau is semilinear for the coordinatewise completed base action.

Apply the semilinear tensor-presentation transport theorem on the small site models. Identify its M tensor_D B with the recorded B tensor_D M by the factor-switching tensor universal property. Transport the additive inverse-image comparisons through the unit-normalized forgetful isomorphisms.

The adjunct agrees on pure tensors by the defining pairing equations. Uniqueness of the completed tensor-pushout action identifies its action with purTwistIntegralModule and gives semilinearity on all sections. The inverse is obtained from the inverse root and constant comparisons; empty schemes and E=Q_l satisfy the same universal properties.

theorem pur_integral_tensor_transport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (α : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y) ⟶
        completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) [IsIso α]
    (τ : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l) [IsIso τ]
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α ≫ completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E X n =
    (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
      (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E Y n) ≫
        proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap h CommRingCat.{u + 1}
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)))))
    (hτ : ∀ n : ℕ,
    τ ≫ limit.π (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower X l (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (op n) =
      (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (limit.π (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (op n)) ≫
          proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageMap h (l ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ ρ : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E)) ⟶
          (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule X l E),
      IsIso ρ ∧
    (∀ (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : (purTwistIntegralConstant Y l E).obj.obj V)
          (t : (purTwistZlModule Y l).val.obj V),
        (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _) ρ).hom.app V
            (purTwistIntegralTensor Y l E V b t) =
          purTwistIntegralTensor X l E ((proEtaleBaseChange h).op.obj V)
            ((proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap h CommRingCat.{u + 1}
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).hom.app
                V b)
            ((((proEtaleSheafAdjunction h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _) τ).hom.app
              V t)) ∧
      ∀ (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E Y).obj.obj V)
          (t : (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E).val.obj V),
        (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _) ρ).hom.app V
            (a • t) =
          @id ((completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E X).obj.obj
            ((proEtaleBaseChange h).op.obj V))
            ((((proEtaleSheafAdjunction h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _) α).hom.app V a) •
          @id ((purTwistIntegralModule X l E).val.obj ((proEtaleBaseChange h).op.obj V))
            ((((proEtaleSheafAdjunction h AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _) ρ).hom.app V t)
